history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Secretariat provide information on the costs of the substantive civilian component of peacekeeping operations
history.administration_response: As agreed by the Administration, the presentation in the budget report will be enhanced to include not only all the number of posts and positions per grade level, but also the costing of this information for all components. In addition, for those missions that have programmatic funding, the information in future budget reports will be further enhanced so that it is also provided by component. The recommendation does not include reporting on the main managerial issues faced, including regarding human resources (long-standing vacancies, long job tenures, risk of underperformance and demotivation, and constraints linked to the applicable policies) and additional reporting on extrabudgetary resources, such as on the nature, level and use of extrabudgetary resources, as well as on the associated administrative costs, including for dealing with budgetary shortfalls to cover substantive matters of the civilian component, a more comprehensive and delineated coverage of the civilian component, notably excluding support functions, giving a break-down by subcomponent and reporting on the volume and use of extrabudgetary funds.
history.board_assessment: The budget report for the 2025/26 period is being updated to include the costs of the substantive civilian component. The Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
